## Purpose
This is the systems-registry subsystem; it owns the full lifecycle of auto-generated "system design" manifests — detecting complex subsystems in the repo, generating + validating + iteratively refining their docs via LLM, injecting relevant context into Claude Code sessions, and serving the registry as a static site or live local viewer.

## Map

- **Pass 0 heuristic detector** → `detect.mjs` · `detect`, `scoreDir`, `_internal`
- **Pass 1 LLM hypothesis** (names + clusters systems from detected candidates) → `pass1.mjs` · `runPass1`, `gatherInputs`, `buildPrompt`, `buildHypothesisMd`, `extractDocgenSummary`
- **Pass 2 per-system body generator** (writes full manifests from hypothesis entries) → `pass2.mjs` · `generateBody`, `gatherInputsFor`, `buildPromptFor`, `readAnchorFiles`, `selectAnchorFiles`, `scoreFilename`, `computeAdaptiveCap`, `_internal.expandGlobs`
- **Pass 2.5 cheap vet** (deterministic + optional LLM check of generated manifests) → `pass25-vet.mjs` · `cheapVet`, `vetSystem`, `findSubflows`, `checkSubflowRegression`, `checkSplittingCandidate`, `_internal`
- **Pass 2.6 revise loop** (re-prompts with vet feedback, ≤2 retries) → `pass26-revise.mjs` · `reviseSystem`, `buildRevisePrompt`
- **Pass 2.7 LLM-as-judge quality scorer** (0–10 on correctness/completeness/sizing/diagram/clarity) → `validate.mjs` · `validateSystem`, `buildValidatePrompt`, `parseValidation`, `writeQualityScore`, `readCachedQuality`, `computeQualityInputHash`, `judgeCommand`
- **Refine loop** (generate → judge → regenerate with feedback, keep-best) → `refine.mjs` · `refineSystem`
- **Incremental refresh** (regenerate only systems whose anchor files changed) → `refresh.mjs` · `refreshIncremental`, `computeImpact`, `loadManifestGlobs`
- **Full pipeline orchestrator** (Pass 0→1→2→2.5→2.6→2.7 + prune orphans) → `run-pipeline.mjs` · `runPipeline`, `parseHypothesisSystems`, `computeValidateScope`, `readRunReport`
- **Manifest loader + glob matcher** (used at hook time to match file paths) → `registry.mjs` · `loadAll`, `match`, `parseFrontMatter`, `globToRegex`, `renderInjection`, `extractMermaid`, `extractAllMermaid`
- **PreToolUse inject hook** (emits matching system context when Claude reads/edits anchor files) → `inject.mjs` · `injectionPlan`, `findRepoRoot`
- **Cross-system composite README generator** (Mermaid flowchart from hypothesis + consumes graph) → `composite.mjs` · `writeCompositeReadme`, `buildCompositeReadme`, `renderCompositeMermaid`, `parseHypothesis`
- **LLM semantic categorizer** (groups systems into sidebar folders) → `organize.mjs` · `runOrganize`, `loadCategories`, `buildOrganizePrompt`, `reconcile`
- **Static site builder** (single self-contained HTML via CSS `:target` routing) → `build-static.mjs` · `buildSite`, `groupSystems`, `sanitizeMermaid`, `stripSubflowSections`, `extractSubflowSections`, `_internal.renderSystemSection`
- **Local dev viewer** (HTTP server with live reload from disk) → `view.mjs` · `startServer`, `_internal.renderPage`
- **Scaffold writer** (skeleton manifest from detection result) → `scaffold.mjs` · `writeManifest`, `manifestText`
- **Mermaid syntax validator + LLM repair** → `validate-mermaid.mjs` · `validateAndRepairBody`, `validateMermaidInBody`, `extractMermaidBlocks`, `spliceMermaidFixes`, `parseRepairReply`
- **LLM retry wrapper** → `llm-retry.mjs` · `withRetry`
- **Repo metadata from git remote** → `repo-meta.mjs` · `repoMeta`, `parseGitRemote`
- **CLI entry point** → `cli.mjs` · all subcommands (`detect`, `scaffold`, `status`, `view`, `build`, `hypothesis`, `vet`, `run`, `refresh`, `validate`, `refine`, `bodies`)
- **Tests** → `*.test.mjs` — hermetic fixtures via `mkdtempSync`, fully injected runners (no real LLM)

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `telemetry/writer.mjs` — inject.mjs calls `writeEvent` for best-effort telemetry on each context injection
- `docs/systems/` — all pipeline output lives here: `*.md` manifests, `_hypothesis.md`, `_categories.json`, `.run-report.json`, `README.md` composite
- Claude CLI (`claude -p`) — spawned for Pass 1, Pass 2, Pass 2.5 LLM vet, Pass 2.7 judge, organize, validate-mermaid repair
- `docgen/` (sibling tool) — inject.mjs deduplication pattern mirrors docgen's `inject-readme-context.mjs`; Pass 1 reads docgen-generated READMEs (Purpose + Map sections only)

## Gotchas
- **Hook stdout vs. model context**: the PreToolUse hook (`inject.mjs`) must emit JSON with `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` — plain stdout goes to the user transcript, not the model. Violating this silently swallows all injected Mermaid diagrams.
- **Submodule root detection**: `inject.mjs`'s `findRepoRoot` first tries `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` to escape submodule scope before falling back to `--show-toplevel`; using `--show-toplevel` alone inside a submodule returns the plugin root (which has no `docs/systems/`), causing 0 systems to load silently.
- **Refine keeps best, not last**: `refine.mjs` snapshots and restores the highest-scoring round's body if later rounds regress structurally — the caller should not assume the on-disk manifest reflects the final round's generation.
